title: Kevin Feige Positions X-Men at the Heart of the MCU's Future
excerpt:
Secret Wars will launch a new era for Marvel.
Feige emphasizes the breadth of X-Men stories.
body_md:
Speaking to Entertainment Weekly, Kevin Feige described Doomsday as a culmination of earlier stories and Secret Wars as a launching pad for a new era. He has previously characterized the transition as a reset rather than a complete reboot.

The report identifies 2028, the MCU's twentieth anniversary, as the start of that era. It lists X-Men for May, a Ryan Gosling Ghost Rider film for July and Black Panther III for December. Those scheduling claims are reported by the feed and have not been independently verified here.

Feige places the X-Men alongside the Avengers and Spider-Man in terms of their importance to Marvel's comics. More than six decades of stories provide opportunities to explore characters and sagas that have received limited screen attention.

Disney's acquisition of Fox made that expansion possible. The report discusses teams such as X-Force and X-Factor as potential avenues, not officially announced projects.

The precise continuity changes after Secret Wars remain unknown. A reset should not be interpreted as confirmation that every existing character or storyline will disappear.
